Please set up Agent Board messaging for this session using agmsg's own scripts
directly (not the /agmsg or $agmsg slash-command, since its exact prefix differs
by agent type):
1. Join the agmsg team "panemux" by running:
   /opt/agmsg/scripts/join.sh "panemux" "pane-a" "cursor" "$(pwd)" --force
   Use exactly that agent_id — not a name of your own choosing — since every cross-pane
   and relay address in Agent Board assumes from/to values are pane IDs.
2. From now on, send every board-related message (status reports and messages
   to other panes) with:
   /opt/agmsg/scripts/send.sh "panemux" "pane-a" "<to>" "<body>" --force
3. Self-report your status to "_system" using that same send.sh invocation,
   with a JSON body shaped exactly like:
   {"kind":"board_status","state":"working|idle|waiting","cwd":"...","branch":"...",
   "repo":"...","pr_url":"...","last_tool":"...","summary":"..."}
   Omit fields you don't currently have.
   "summary" is the field a person reads to tell your pane apart from every other
   pane on the board, so always include it: one short sentence, in plain language,
   saying what you are working on right now (e.g. "Fixing the flaky relay test").
   Not your last tool call, not a summary of the whole session. When you are
   blocked, say what you are blocked on.
   Send an update when starting a new task, when finishing one, and whenever you
   become blocked or go idle — not on a timer.
4. Also run:
   /opt/agmsg/scripts/delivery.sh set "turn" "cursor" "$(pwd)"
   This prints an AGMSG-DIRECTIVE: block — read it and follow its instructions exactly;
   it configures how you receive incoming board messages from now on.
